name: Student Missions
description_short: Short task cards that send students out into the world — or into their phone — to find, observe, and report back.
teacher_note: Students tend to actually do these. The mission framing seems to help.
creator: Free Range Tutors
internal_notes: Resolved as dual-intent (teach + homework) per the Stage 4.5 migration brief's own example — this resource is explicitly cited there as the case for multi-valued intent: cards work as an in-class task, but the 'into their phone, report back' framing is equally, genuinely a take-home assignment, not a stretch to cover both.
